episode.subject: southern masked weaver
episode.title: I put it down to look
episode.body:
I chose a green piece without a single brown edge. Carried it all the way back. Now the leaves are in front of my eyes. I turn my head; they come with me.

I put it down to look for the entrance. Watched it fall past the nest.
